feeds.title: Reshoring Verband
feeds.description: The Association for Reshoring and Fair Competition advocates for the relocation of production to Europe and fair global competitive conditions. Short and secure supply chains, and personal contacts with European suppliers without quality surprises secure jobs and protect the climate. We are against price dumping, government subsidies that distort competition, forced labor in production, and environmentally harmful production methods.
